Brigittenau (20. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Local press repeatedly flags the Handelskai riverside strip and Maria-Restituta-Platz for youth conflicts, fights and vandalism, with police confirming property damage (mostly graffiti) makes up the largest share of reported offences there, and describing incidents as isolated rather than a rising trend (meinbezirk.at, Feb 2024). A 22-year-old was stabbed in the thigh during a dispute on Handelskai in May 2024 (meinbezirk.at). More seriously, in July 2024 a violent feud between two loosely organised gangs escalated into stabbings and armed confrontations concentrated in Brigittenau, at Anton-Kummerer-Park, the U6 Jägerstraße station and Hannovermarkt, prompting large police operations with hundreds of ID checks and weapons seizures (meinbezirk.at, Jul 2024). In late 2025 police also raided a 'bunker apartment' in the district, seizing over 20 kg of drugs (cannabis, cocaine, ketamine) plus a firearm (meinbezirk.at, Nov 2025). Daytime foot patrols and video surveillance have since been stepped up around Handelskai. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, "Prügel, Messerattacken & Co.: Wie sicher ist die Lage am Wiener Handelskai?" (13 Feb 2024); meinbezirk.at, "22-Jähriger bei Messerattacke am Handelskai verletzt" (3 May 2024); meinbezirk.at, "Brutale Fehde: So geht die Wiener Polizei gegen den Bandenkrieg vor" (Jul 2024); meinbezirk.at, "Brigittenau: Mehr als 20 Kilogramm Drogen in Bunkerwohnung gefunden" (3 Nov 2025).
